sources.title: Guide of an Veigar OTP star zall I Challenger Veigar OTP 3260 LP Peak I
Veigar Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.text: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.text: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.text: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.text: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.text: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

damage.value: Veigar deals AP burst damage with his combo.

archetype.value: Veigar is a mage who uses a cage for crowd control and builds AP through stacks.

axis.value: Veigar plays a weaker early lane and gains good waveclear after level 9.

winCondition.value: Veigar wins by scaling into a strong mid-to-late-game champion with cage control and burst damage.

spikes.why: Veigar gains good waveclear after level 9.
Veigar becomes strong as his stacks give him more AP.
Veigar's Primordial Burst gains damage and has a shorter cooldown as it ranks up.

bait.why: Veigar’s W can be dodged, leaving its damage unavailable until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Veigar players risk losing their escape when they spend Flash while vulnerable to a gank.
Veigar misses a chance at permanent Ability Power when he overlooks units he could kill with Baleful Strike.
